wish: someone should make an app that quizzes you on the titles of your own songs
spec:
Quizzes you on the titles of a song list you type or paste, one per line as title - artist.
You get the artist and the initials of the title, then pick from four titles or type it; a score is kept.
It does not play audio, bundle any songs or lyrics, or send anything anywhere.
notes: Offline version: no audio playback; the player supplies their own list of titles.
